purpose: Engineering evidence and decisions; claims are paraphrases, not normative quotations

sources.title: Agent Skills format specification
sources.finding: SKILL.md and portable metadata are the minimum skill contract
sources.engineering_implication: Validate directory/name/description and references; distinguish strict format from policy

sources.title: OpenAI Build Skills
sources.finding: Skills should be focused; descriptions control implicit matching
sources.engineering_implication: Require trigger and negative-trigger examples; retain optional OpenAI metadata

sources.title: OpenAI Codex customization
sources.finding: AGENTS.md and SKILL.md serve distinct roles; Codex finds repo skills in .agents/skills
sources.engineering_implication: Use repo policy separately from the skill entrypoint

sources.title: OpenAI Plugins Skills
sources.finding: MCP tools expose capabilities while skills encode workflows
sources.engineering_implication: Do not confuse repository skills with connectors or remote execution

sources.title: VS Code Agent Skills
sources.finding: Clients may discover several skill directories
sources.engineering_implication: Use canonical .agents/skills; validate client-specific installation instead of assuming equivalence

sources.title: OpenAI Codex engineering workflows
sources.finding: AGENTS.md can contain durable repository operating instructions
sources.engineering_implication: Keep acceptance gates and phased planning versioned

sources.title: OpenAI Skills old catalog README
sources.finding: The old catalog now directs readers to newer plugin guidance
sources.engineering_implication: Do not base current installations on obsolete catalog instructions

sources.title: OpenAI prompt injection safety
sources.finding: Untrusted content can redirect an agent toward unintended actions
sources.engineering_implication: Constrain scopes, obtain confirmation, and avoid broad tool authority

sources.title: OpenAI agent builder safety
sources.finding: Use tool approvals, constrained inputs, and trace evaluations
sources.engineering_implication: Add adversarial and side-effect tests before release

sources.title: GitHub secure your organization
sources.finding: Workflows should minimize token permissions and pin external actions
sources.engineering_implication: Use read-only permission and no external Actions in bootstrap CI

sources.title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
sources.finding: Govern, Map, Measure, Manage give risk-program structure
sources.engineering_implication: Map assurance gates to governance, measurement, and risk response

sources.title: MCP Skills Extension specification
sources.finding: MCP-served skill text is untrusted and local execution requires approval
sources.engineering_implication: Do not assume remotely supplied skills grant execution authority
